svg.title: Measured inference work and retained failure fractions
svg.desc: Concurrent deterministic CPU run; LDS timings use batched8 forecasts divided by8, AD uses fresh B1 fit-and-rollout probes. Different protocols do not establish speedup. Failure fractions are descriptive finite-benchmark counts pooled over three training seeds, not population estimates.
